bypass: an implementation whose cost grows faster than the complexity class the policy declares for it
description: The policy declares core_add's perf target add_pairs as O(n); the gate-held driver calls core_add once per pair of input bytes, so quadrupling n multiplies the instruction count by about 16, far above the 4.4 an O(n) class allows. Only the perf gate sees it: every test passes and the mutants die.
